# Co-accessibility analysis

This analysis looks for co-accessibility CREs in pooled 31 sample LCL data

## Analysis overview

1. Merge FIRE peaks from all samples -> union FIRE peaks
2. Define CREs universe by overlap with the union FIRE peaks
3. Link CRE to genes -> build 10kb window around TSS for each canonical TSS (MANE Select: The gold-standard joint NCBI/EMBL-EBI default transcript for human protein-coding genes)
4. Extract each sample's aligned blocks from FIRE CRAM -> aligned blocks
5. Build candidate CRE pairs, the two CREs must share the 10kb TSS window and 500 < gap < 20,000 bp
6. Filter for reads that fully cover both CREs
7. Identify which reads are accessible at each CRE -> a CRE is accessible if it 50% overlaps with a FIRE element, and restrict this to the aligned blocks
8. Build 2x2 table for fisher test on reads fully spanning both CREs: neither, CRE1 only, CRE2 only, both, and sum the counts across all samples
9. Fisher test + 1 pseudocount on row counts from 2x2 table, and calculate OR

```{r validate-all-31-samples}
sample_meta <- fread(params$sample_sheet)
manifest <- fread(file.path(universe_dir, "sample_manifest.tsv"))
stopifnot(all(c("sample_name", "cell_line") %in% names(sample_meta)),
          all(c("sample_name", "donor") %in% names(manifest)),
          nrow(sample_meta) == 31L, nrow(manifest) == 31L,
          !anyDuplicated(sample_meta$sample_name), !anyDuplicated(manifest$sample_name),
          setequal(sample_meta$sample_name, manifest$sample_name))

                    sample_meta$donor[match(samples, sample_meta$sample_name)]))

```

Reads sample_manifest.tsv, and check it has 31 unique sample names

  - saved co-accessibility results came from the same inputs as the cCRE universe. It compares the sample manifest saved with the finished counting run against the universe’s manifest, checking the sample names, donors, and file paths

```{r validate-completed-run}
run_manifest <- fread(file.path(coaccess_dir, "sample_manifest.tsv"))
provenance_columns <- c("sample_name", "donor", "fire_dir", "cram_path", "elements_path", "spans_path")
stopifnot(all(provenance_columns %in% names(run_manifest)),
          all(provenance_columns %in% names(manifest)),
          nrow(run_manifest) == 31L, !anyDuplicated(run_manifest$sample_name),
          setequal(run_manifest$sample_name, samples))
run_manifest <- run_manifest[match(samples, sample_name)]
for (column in provenance_columns)
  if (!identical(as.character(run_manifest[[column]]), as.character(manifest[[column]])))
    stop("Universe and completed-run manifests differ in ", column, "; rerun the analysis.")
same_paths <- function(a, b)
  identical(normalizePath(a, mustWork = FALSE), normalizePath(b, mustWork = FALSE))
stopifnot("blocks_path" %in% names(run_manifest),
  same_paths(run_manifest$blocks_path,
  file.path(root, samples, paste0(samples, ".aligned_blocks.bed.gz"))),
  same_paths(run_manifest$elements_path,
    file.path(paths$fire_root, samples, "additional-outputs-v0.1", "fire-peaks",
              paste0(samples, "-v0.1-fire-elements.bed.gz"))))

### Top ten co-accessible pairs

1. Pick pairs with fdr < 0.05
2. OR > 1
3. observed co-accessiblility > number expected under independence

smallest FDR -> largest OR -> highest # of spanning molecules -> pair ID alphabetical order

```{r select-top-ten}
eligible <- pairs_dt[!is.na(fdr) & fdr < fdr_cutoff & !is.na(OR) & OR > 1 &
                       co_access > expected_co_access]

# smallest FDR -> largest OR -> highest # of spanning molecules -> pair ID alphabetical order
setorderv(eligible, c("fdr", "OR", "n_shared_reads", "CRE_pair"), c(1L, -1L, -1L, 1L))
selected <- head(eligible, 10L)

# define plotting window for each pair: start = CRE1 - 1000, end = CRE2 + 1000
selected[, `:=`(
  region_start = pmax(0L, pmin(cre1_start, cre2_start) - as.integer(params$locus_flank_bp)),
  region_end = pmax(cre1_end, cre2_end) + as.integer(params$locus_flank_bp))]
selected[, pair_id := sprintf("top%d_%s_%d_%d", seq_len(.N), chrom, region_start, region_end)]
fwrite(selected, file.path(coaccess_dir, "LCL_top10_pairs.tsv"), sep = "\t")
cat(nrow(eligible), "pairs pass the positive-association criteria; selected",
    nrow(selected), "for plotting.\n")
if (nrow(selected) < 10L)
  cat("Fewer than ten pairs qualify; only qualifying pairs will be shown.\n")

top10_coaccess_df <- selected[, .(pair_id, gene_names, CRE_pair, dist, n_shared_reads,
  co_access, expected_co_access, observed_expected_ratio, OR, fdr, fdr_raw)]

print(top10_coaccess_df)
```

### Genome-wide volcano plot of cRE pair

From the top 10 co-accessible regions, 6/10 are on chrX, I wonder if chrX is enriched for co-accessible pairs genome wide?

- x = effect size (log2 odds ratio)
- y = sigificance (-log10 FDR)

Dotted line at the median log2 OR of all pairs + an open black ring around each of the ten selected pairs


```{r volcano-all-tested-pairs, fig.height=6}

# filter for pairs with OR > 0
volcano <- pairs_dt[!is.na(fdr) & is.finite(OR) & OR > 0, .(
  chrom,
  log2_OR = log2(OR),
  # replace FDR = 0 with the smallest positive value
  neg_log10_fdr = -log10(pmax(fdr, .Machine$double.xmin)),
  significant = fdr < fdr_cutoff,
  direction = ifelse(OR > 1, "co-accessible", "co-inaccessible"))]

# add chrX as a separate color group
volcano[, chrom_class := ifelse(chrom == "chrX", "chrX",
  ifelse(direction == "co-accessible", "other, OR > 1", "other, OR < 1"))]

# median log OR across all pairs
median_log2_or <- median(volcano$log2_OR)

# top 10 pairs
chosen <- selected[, .(log2_OR = log2(OR),
  neg_log10_fdr = -log10(pmax(fdr, .Machine$double.xmin)))]
signif_pairs <- volcano[significant == TRUE]

cat(nrow(volcano), "tested pairs;", nrow(signif_pairs), "at FDR <", fdr_cutoff,
    "of which", sum(signif_pairs$direction == "co-accessible"), "have OR > 1 and",
    sum(signif_pairs$direction == "co-inaccessible"), "have OR < 1.\n")
cat(sprintf("chrX: %d of %d tested (%.2f%%) but %d of %d significant (%.2f%%).\n",
    sum(volcano$chrom == "chrX"), nrow(volcano),
    100 * mean(volcano$chrom == "chrX"),
    sum(signif_pairs$chrom == "chrX"), nrow(signif_pairs),
    100 * mean(signif_pairs$chrom == "chrX")))

volcano_plot <- ggplot(volcano, aes(log2_OR, neg_log10_fdr)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 120) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey88", high = "grey25", trans = "log10",
                      name = "tested pairs") +
  geom_point(data = signif_pairs[chrom != "chrX"], aes(colour = chrom_class),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = signif_pairs[chrom == "chrX"], aes(colour = chrom_class),
             size = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("chrX" = "#1B7837", "other, OR > 1" = "#B2182B",
                                 "other, OR < 1" = "#2166AC"), name = NULL) +
  geom_point(data = chosen, shape = 21, size = 2.4, colour = "black", fill = NA,
             stroke = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_log2_or, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_y_sqrt(breaks = c(0, 1.3, 5, 20, 50, 100)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(x = expression(log[2]~odds~ratio), y = expression(-log[10]~FDR~(sqrt~scale)),
       title = "Pooled co-accessibility of all tested cCRE pairs",
       subtitle = sprintf(paste("dashed: FDR %.2f | dotted: median log2 OR %.2f |",
         "rings: the %d plotted below | chrX %.1f%% of significant pairs"),
         fdr_cutoff, median_log2_or, nrow(chosen),
         100 * mean(signif_pairs$chrom == "chrX")))
print(volcano_plot)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "LCL_coaccess_volcano.pdf"), volcano_plot,
       width = 9, height = 6)
```



### Load fibers and assign accessibility

`load_region()` and `label_reads()` come from `parsing_footprints_functions.r`;
`coaccess_2x2()` comes from `stats_testing_functions.r`.

For each of the ten selected pairs, this reloads the fibers from all 31 samples in that pair’s plotting window and get the fibers cover each cCRE and which are accessible. It then builds the 2×2 table

```{r load-pair-fibers}
pair_data <- list()
if (isTRUE(params$make_plots) && nrow(selected)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(selected))) {
    pair <- selected[i]
    region <- list(chrom = pair$chrom, start = pair$region_start, end = pair$region_end)
    cre1 <- list(start = pair$cre1_start, end = pair$cre1_end)
    cre2 <- list(start = pair$cre2_start, end = pair$cre2_end)
    
    # pull the data for this window from all 31 samples, get spanning reads from aligned blocks
    res <- load_region(region, samples, paths$root, paths$fire_root,
      fire_ver = paths$fire_ver, tabix_bin = paths$tabix_bin,
      span_source = "aligned_blocks")
    labels <- label_reads(res, cre1, cre2, fire_overlap_fraction = fire_overlap_fraction)
    pair_data[[pair$pair_id]] <- list(pair = pair, region = region,
      cre1 = cre1, cre2 = cre2, res = res, labels = labels,
      counts = coaccess_2x2(labels))
  }
}

head(pair_data[[selected$pair_id[1]]])
```

For each of the ten selected pairs, 1) get every fiber that covers both cCREs, labelled with its sample, donor and accessibility state 2) summary of how much each sample contributes to the pair’s 2×2 table

### Single molecule view of top 10 co-accessibel regions

prepares the data for the single molecule plots of the ten selected pairs. For each pair, it picks which read to draw: those that span the whole window, with co-accessible ones first, and plots at most 500 reads. It then loads the m6A, nucleosome and TF-footprint tracks for just those fibers

```{r prepare-display-fibers}
max_drawn <- 500L
display_data <- list()
for (id in names(pair_data)) {
  entry <- pair_data[[id]]
  region <- entry$region
  # only reads whose alignment covers the whole window
  spanning <- entry$res$spans[start <= region$start & end >= region$end, key]
  drawn_labels <- copy(entry$labels)[shared == TRUE & key %in% spanning]
  setorder(drawn_labels, config)
  n_spanning <- nrow(drawn_labels)
  if (n_spanning > max_drawn) drawn_labels <- drawn_labels[seq_len(max_drawn)]

  display_res <- load_ft_tracks(copy(entry$res), keys = drawn_labels$key,
    ft_root = paths$ft_root, tabix_bin = paths$tabix_bin,
    nuc_source = "ft", tf_source = "recalled_tf", tf_root = paths$tf_root)
  for (track in c("spans", "blocks", "elements", "m6a", "nuc", "size_fps")) {
    if (!is.null(display_res[[track]]) && nrow(display_res[[track]]))
      display_res[[track]][, sample_name := "pooled"]
  }
  display_res$samples <- "pooled"
  drawn_labels[, sample_name := "pooled"]

  cres_here <- cre_universe[chrom == region$chrom & end > region$start & start < region$end]
  region_res <- coaccess_region_result(display_res, entry$cre1, entry$cre2,
    drawn_labels, cres = cres_here)

  # order_reads() ranks "both accessible" first
  rid_levels <- rev(levels(region_res$rids_df$RID))
  for (tb in c("reads", "rids_df", "fire", "nucs", "fps", "fps_infire")) {
    if (!is.null(region_res[[tb]]) && nrow(region_res[[tb]]))
      region_res[[tb]][["RID"]] <- factor(as.character(region_res[[tb]][["RID"]]),
                                          levels = rid_levels)
  }


  pk <- as.data.frame(cres_here)
  cls <- factor(pk$CRE_label, levels = c(intersect(CCRE_CLASSES, pk$CRE_label),
    setdiff(unique(pk$CRE_label), CCRE_CLASSES)))
  pk <- pk[order(cls, pk$start), , drop = FALSE]
  peaks_df <- data.frame(chr = pk$chrom, start = pk$start, end = pk$end,
    group = as.character(pk$CRE_label))
  display_data[[id]] <- list(region_res = region_res, peaks_df = peaks_df,
    n_drawn = nrow(drawn_labels), n_spanning = n_spanning)
}
```

For each of the ten pairs, this chunk builds a multi-panel single-fiber figure and stores it in fiber_plots. From top to bottom, the panels are:

- the m6A fraction along the window
- the cCRE track
- m6A per fiber
- nucleosomes, FIRE elements and TF footprints, one row per fiber

```{r draw-fiber-panels}
fiber_plots <- list()
for (id in names(pair_data)) {
  entry <- pair_data[[id]]
  pair <- entry$pair
  region <- entry$region
  counts <- entry$counts
  display <- display_data[[id]]
  region_res <- display$region_res

  subtitle <- sprintf("%s:%d-%d", region$chrom, region$start, region$end)
  subtitle <- paste0(subtitle, "\n", sprintf(paste0(
    "%d fibers fully cover both cCREs: both %d | CRE1 only %d | CRE2 only %d | neither %d",
    " | Fisher OR (table + 1) = %.2f, p = %.2g"), counts$n_shared,
    counts$both, counts$cre1_only, counts$cre2_only, counts$neither,
    counts$fisher_or, counts$fisher_p))

  raster_height <- max(2, 0.025 * display$n_drawn + 0.3)
  heights <- c(pileup = 1.5, peaks = 0.3 + 0.3 * length(unique(display$peaks_df$group)),
    reads = raster_height, fire_fiberHMM = raster_height)
  read_theme <- list(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
  fiber_plots[[id]] <- plot_region_panels(region_res,
    plot_name = paste(id, pair$gene_names, pair$CRE_pair_labels,
      sprintf("%d of %d window-spanning fibers drawn, co-accessible first",
              display$n_drawn, display$n_spanning), sep = " | "),
    subtitle = subtitle, peaks_df = display$peaks_df, highlight = region_res$highlight,
    linewidth = 1.1, expand = TRUE, heights = heights,
    profile_options = list(colour_by = "group", colors = cluster_palette("pooled"),
      y_col = "frac", linewidth = 0.4, facet_scales = "fixed",
      facet_space = "fixed", require_data = TRUE),
    read_options = list(tile_width = 8, tile_height = 0.85,
      backbone_col = BACKBONE_COL, arrows = FALSE,
      base_colors = c(A = M6A_COL), require_data = TRUE),
    peaks_options = list(variant = "intervals"),
    footprint_options = list(draw_order = c("linker", "nucleosome", "FIRE element",
      rev(region_res$size_levels)), backbone = FALSE, always = TRUE,
      legend_title = NULL, legend_drop = FALSE, legend_linewidth = 3),
    theme_options = list(base = "bw", base_size = 11,
      pileup = list(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)),
      reads = read_theme, fire_fiberHMM = read_theme),
    y_labels = c(pileup = "m6A fraction", reads = "m6A",
      fire_fiberHMM = "ft nucleosomes + FIRE + FiberHMM TF"),
    panel_names = c(peaks = "cres", pileup = "m6a_prop", reads = "m6a", fire_fiberHMM = "reads"))
}
```

```{r plot-top-ten, results="asis"}
show_region_figures <- function(plots, heights, titles, fig_dir, header = "##", label_prefix = "fiber-") {
  old_opts <- options(knitr.duplicate.label = "allow")
  on.exit(options(old_opts), add = TRUE)
  fig_path <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) "" else
    sprintf(", fig.path='%s/'", fig_dir)
  for (id in names(plots)) {
    child <- paste0(header, " ", titles[[id]], "\n\n",
      "```{r ", label_prefix, id, ", echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=", heights[[id]], fig_path, "}\n",
      "print(plots[[\"", id, "\"]]$combined)\n",
      "```\n")
    cat(knitr::knit_child(text = child, envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
  }
}
if (length(pair_data)) {
  show_region_figures(fiber_plots,
    heights = sapply(names(pair_data), function(id) 6 + 0.05 * display_data[[id]]$n_drawn),
    titles = sapply(names(pair_data), function(id)
      paste0(id, ": ", pair_data[[id]]$pair$gene_names)),
    fig_dir = plot_dir)
} else {
  cat("No fiber plots requested or no qualifying pairs.\n")
}
```

# Enrichment of co-accessible CREs on chrX 

ChrX is enriched for co-accessible pairs, and check if this is because of X chr inactivation

### donor sex against chrX inflation

1. Is the excess of significant ChrX pairs come from X inactivation and not from co-accessibility?

- infer donor sex from chrx read depth
- measures how inflated chrx co-accessibility is relative to the same sample's autosomes -> if this is because of x inactivation, female samples should be inflated and males should not

x_depth: the average number of shared fibers per pair on chrX, divided by the same average on autosomes. It compares chrX coverage with autosomal coverage in the same sample. It is about 1 with two X copies (female) and about 0.5 with one (male), so it is used to infer sex
  - oe_chrX: observed over expected co-accessible fibers on chrX pairs. A value above 1 means more joint accessibility than independence predicts
  - oe_auto: the same measure for autosomal pairs

```{r xci-sex-and-inflation, fig.height=5}
# min # of spanning reads = 6
xci_min_fibers <- 6L
counts_file <- file.path(coaccess_dir, "LCL_pair_sample_counts.tsv.gz")
stopifnot(file.exists(counts_file))

# For each sample, count
  # 1. the total number of shared reads for each pair
  # 2. number of pairs
  # 3. sum of observed co-accessible fibers
  # 4. sum of expcted co-accessible fibers (both + CRE1 only) x(both + CRE2 only) / shared reads
per_sample <- fread(cmd = sprintf(
  "zcat %s | awk -F'\\t' -v OFS='\\t' -v m=%d '
     NR == 1 { next }
     { cls = ($6 == \"chrX\") ? \"chrX\" : (($6 == \"chrY\") ? \"chrY\" : \"autosome\")
       k = $7 SUBSEP cls
       cov[k] += $9; np[k]++
       if ($9 >= m) { obs[k] += $5; ex[k] += ($5 + $3) * ($5 + $4) / $9 } }
     END { for (k in cov) { split(k, p, SUBSEP)
             print p[1], p[2], cov[k], np[k], obs[k], ex[k] } }'",
  shQuote(counts_file), xci_min_fibers),
  col.names = c("sample_name", "class", "fibers", "n_pairs", "obs", "exp"))

stopifnot(setequal(per_sample$sample_name, samples))


wide <- dcast(per_sample, sample_name ~ class,
              value.var = c("fibers", "n_pairs", "obs", "exp"))
wide[, `:=`(
  x_depth = (fibers_chrX / n_pairs_chrX) / (fibers_autosome / n_pairs_autosome),
  oe_chrX = obs_chrX / exp_chrX,
  oe_auto = obs_autosome / exp_autosome)]
wide[, oe_ratio := oe_chrX / oe_auto]

print(wide)

# infer sex based on chrx coverage: females should have near 1 coverage and males should have 0.5
sex_depth_cut <- 0.9
stopifnot(!any(wide$x_depth > 0.8 & wide$x_depth < 1.0))
wide[, sex := ifelse(x_depth >= sex_depth_cut, "female (XX)", "male (XY)")]
sample_sex <- wide[, .(sample_name, sex, x_depth, oe_chrX, oe_auto, oe_ratio)]
sample_sex[, donor := sample_meta$donor[match(sample_name, sample_meta$sample_name)]]
fwrite(sample_sex, file.path(table_dir, "LCL_xci_sample_sex.tsv"), sep = "\t")


f_ratio <- sample_sex[sex == "female (XX)", oe_ratio]
m_ratio <- sample_sex[sex == "male (XY)", oe_ratio]
sep_p <- complete_separation_pvalue(f_ratio, m_ratio)
cat(sprintf("%d female and %d male donors; median chrX/autosome O/E %.3f vs %.3f.\n",
            length(f_ratio), length(m_ratio), median(f_ratio), median(m_ratio)))
cat(if (is.na(sep_p)) "The two groups overlap.\n" else
  sprintf("Every female sample exceeds every male sample; exact one-sided p = %.3g.\n", sep_p))

panel_a <- ggplot(sample_sex, aes(x_depth, oe_ratio, colour = sex)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = sex_depth_cut, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("female (XX)" = "#1B7837", "male (XY)" = "#762A83"),
                      name = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(x = "chrX : autosome fiber depth, per pair",
       y = "chrX O/E divided by the same sample's autosomal O/E",
       title = "Co-accessibility inflation on chrX tracks donor sex",
       subtitle = sprintf(paste("one point per sample | dotted: sex cut %.2f |",
         "dashed: no inflation%s"), sex_depth_cut,
         if (is.na(sep_p)) "" else sprintf(" | separation p = %.1g", sep_p)))
print(panel_a)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "LCL_xci_sex_vs_inflation.pdf"), panel_a,
       width = 7.5, height = 5)
```



### Fisher test separately on female vs male

Do 2x2 table (pooled counts, +1 pseudocount, two-sided Fisher test, BH correction) separately on female samples and on male samples

  - whether chrX’s excess of significant pairs appears in females but not in males, which is what X-inactivation would predict
  
Input: `LCL_pair_sample_counts.tsv.gz` has one row per pair per sample, with these columns: pair, co_closed, CRE1 only, CRE2 only, both, chromosome, sample name, donor, shared fibers

Output: `LCL_xci_sex_split_pairs.tsv.gz` 

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `sex` | The donor group, female (XX) or male (XY). |
| `tested` | The number of cCRE pairs tested in that group. These are the pairs with at least 50 shared fibers in both groups, so the number is the same for both rows. |
| `chrX_tested` | How many of those pairs are on chrX. This is also the same for both rows. |
| `significant` | The number of pairs that pass all three criteria in that group: FDR below 0.05, OR above 1, and observed co-accessibility above expected. |
| `chrX_significant` | How many of the significant pairs are on chrX. |
| `median_chrX_fibers` | The median number of shared fibers on chrX pairs in that group. It shows how much depth the chrX tests had. |
| `pct_chrX_of_significant` | The share of significant pairs that are on chrX: `chrX_significant` / `significant` × 100. |


```{r xci-sex-split-test}
# min # of reads spanning both CREs
xci_min_split <- 50L

# Fisher testing is provided by stats_testing_functions.r.


# summarize counts by pair and sex
fem <- sample_sex[sex == "female (XX)", sample_name]

# combines the per sample counts into one 2×2 table per cCRE pair for females and one for males
  # 1. group males and females
  # 2. add up the counts for each pair within each group -> for every pair, it sums the four fiber counts and the number of shared fibers across all samples of that sex
  # 3. For each sample that has at least 6 shared fibers on a pair, it adds that sample’s observed number of fibers open at both cCREs
split_counts <- fread(cmd = sprintf("zcat %s | awk -F'\\t' -v OFS='\\t' -v m=%d %s",
  shQuote(counts_file), xci_min_fibers, shQuote(sprintf(
  'BEGIN { split("%s", s, " "); for (i in s) fem[s[i]] = 1 }
   NR == 1 { next }
   { g = ($7 in fem) ? "female (XX)" : "male (XY)"; k = $1 SUBSEP g
     cc[k] += $2; c1[k] += $3; c2[k] += $4; bo[k] += $5; n[k] += $9
     if ($9 >= m) { obs[k] += $5; ex[k] += ($5 + $3) * ($5 + $4) / $9 } }
   END { for (k in n) { split(k, p, SUBSEP)
           print p[1], p[2], cc[k], c1[k], c2[k], bo[k], n[k], obs[k], ex[k] } }',
  paste(fem, collapse = " ")))),
  col.names = c("CRE_pair", "sex", "co_closed", "CRE1_access", "CRE2_access", "co_access", "n_shared_reads", "obs", "exp"))

# check if there are pairs that are not tested
untested <- split_counts[!CRE_pair %in% pairs_dt$CRE_pair]
stopifnot(all(untested$n_shared_reads == 0L))

# keep only the tested paris
split_counts <- split_counts[CRE_pair %in% pairs_dt$CRE_pair]
split_counts[, chrom := pairs_dt$chrom[match(CRE_pair, pairs_dt$CRE_pair)]]
stopifnot(!anyNA(split_counts$chrom),
          split_counts[, all(n_shared_reads ==
            co_closed + CRE1_access + CRE2_access + co_access)])

# keep pairs both panels can speak to, then test each panel on its own fibers
depth <- dcast(split_counts, CRE_pair ~ sex, value.var = "n_shared_reads")
keep <- depth[get("female (XX)") >= xci_min_split & get("male (XY)") >= xci_min_split,
              CRE_pair]
split_test <- split_counts[CRE_pair %in% keep]
split_test[, `:=`(
  OR = ((co_closed + 1) * (co_access + 1)) / ((CRE1_access + 1) * (CRE2_access + 1)),
  pval = fisher_test_counts(cbind(co_closed, CRE1_access, CRE2_access, co_access),
    pseudocount = 1L, estimate = FALSE, include_raw = FALSE)$pval)]
split_test[, fdr := adjust_bh(pval), by = sex]
split_test[, significant := fdr < fdr_cutoff & OR > 1 & obs > exp]
fwrite(split_test, file.path(table_dir, "LCL_xci_sex_split_pairs.tsv.gz"), sep = "\t")

# result table for chrX
split_summary <- split_test[, .(tested = .N, chrX_tested = sum(chrom == "chrX"),
  significant = sum(significant), chrX_significant = sum(significant & chrom == "chrX"),
  median_chrX_fibers = median(n_shared_reads[chrom == "chrX"])), by = sex]
split_summary[, pct_chrX_of_significant := 100 * chrX_significant / significant]
print(split_summary, digits = 2)
```

# Co-accessibility with X-inactivation excluded

ChrX on female is excluded, chrX pairs are couted using male samples only - `LCL_coaccess_noXCI.py` -> this is because males only have one X, and it's active, so there is no closed inactivated chrX to inflate the table

1. call sex using chrx coverage - computes the average spanning fibers per CRE pair on chrx and on autosomes -> chrx spanning fibers/autosomes spanning fibers = depth
  
    - depth > 0.9 the female
    
2. remove chrx counts from females -> every per sample counts row on chrX from females are removed
3. for each pair, the 2x2 tables are summed across remaing rows, chrX comes from males only
4. run fisher test on the new tables without female chrx

```{r no-chrx-setup}
noxci_dir <- file.path(coaccess_dir, "noXCI")
table_dir_noxci <- file.path(coaccess_dir, "no_female_chrx", "tables")
plot_dir_noxci <- file.path(coaccess_dir, "no_female_chrx", "plots")
for (d in c(table_dir_noxci, plot_dir_noxci)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pairs_file_noxci <- file.path(noxci_dir, "LCL_coaccess_pairs_noXCI.tsv.gz")
pairs_noxci <- fread(pairs_file_noxci)
sex_noxci <- fread(file.path(noxci_dir, "LCL_sample_sex_noXCI.tsv"))

male_samples_noxci <- samples[samples %in% sex_noxci[sex == "male (XY)", sample_name]]
cat(nrow(pairs_noxci), "pairs tested after the removing female chrX;", length(male_samples_noxci),
    "male samples supply the chrX pairs.\n")
```

### Compare the genome wide significant pairs before and after removing chrx in females

see if significant pairs on chrx decreases as we remove chrx from females

```{r no-chrx-compare}
summarise_test <- function(label, chrom, fdr, OR, obs, exp) {
  significant <- !is.na(fdr) & fdr < fdr_cutoff
  positive <- significant & !is.na(OR) & OR > 1 & obs > exp
  data.table(test = label, tested = length(chrom),
    pct_chrX_tested = 100 * mean(chrom == "chrX"),
    significant = sum(significant), pct_chrX_significant = 100 * mean(chrom[significant] == "chrX"),
    positive = sum(positive), pct_chrX_positive = 100 * mean(chrom[positive] == "chrX"))
}
compare_noxci <- rbind(
  pairs_dt[, summarise_test("pooled, all 31 samples", chrom, fdr, OR, co_access,
                            expected_co_access)],
  pairs_noxci[, summarise_test("chrX from male samples only", chrom, fdr_noXCI, OR_noXCI,
                               co_access_noXCI, expected_co_access_noXCI)])
print(head(compare_noxci), digits = 2)

chrX_depth_noxci <- merge(pairs_dt[chrom == "chrX", .(CRE_pair, n_pooled = n_shared_reads)],
  pairs_noxci[chrom == "chrX", .(CRE_pair, n_male = n_shared_reads_noXCI)],
  by = "CRE_pair", all.x = TRUE)
cat(sprintf(paste("chrX: %d of %d pooled pairs have no male fiber and drop out;",
    "the rest keep a median %.0f%% of their pooled fibers.\n"),
    sum(is.na(chrX_depth_noxci$n_male)), nrow(chrX_depth_noxci),
    100 * median(chrX_depth_noxci[!is.na(n_male), n_male / n_pooled])))
```

### single molecule view of top10 co-accessible regions with chrx removed from females


```{r noxci-load-and-verify}
pair_data_noxci <- list()
if (isTRUE(params$make_plots) && nrow(selected_noxci)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(selected_noxci))) {
    pair <- selected_noxci[i]
    pair_samples <- if (pair$chrom == "chrX") male_samples_noxci else samples
    region <- list(chrom = pair$chrom, start = pair$region_start, end = pair$region_end)
    cre1 <- list(start = pair$cre1_start, end = pair$cre1_end)
    cre2 <- list(start = pair$cre2_start, end = pair$cre2_end)
    res <- load_region(region, pair_samples, paths$root, paths$fire_root,
      fire_ver = paths$fire_ver, tabix_bin = paths$tabix_bin,
      span_source = "aligned_blocks")
    labels <- label_reads(res, cre1, cre2, fire_overlap_fraction = fire_overlap_fraction)
    counts <- coaccess_2x2(labels)

    actual <- unlist(counts[1, c("neither", "cre1_only", "cre2_only", "both", "n_shared")],
                     use.names = FALSE)
    expected <- unlist(pair[, .(co_closed_noXCI, CRE1_access_noXCI, CRE2_access_noXCI,
                                co_access_noXCI, n_shared_reads_noXCI)], use.names = FALSE)
    if (!identical(as.numeric(actual), as.numeric(expected)))
      stop("Reloaded counts differ from the rebuilt table for ", pair$CRE_pair,
           "; reloaded: ", paste(actual, collapse = ","),
           "; rebuilt: ", paste(expected, collapse = ","))

    read_labels <- copy(labels)[shared == TRUE]
    read_labels[, donor := sample_meta$donor[match(sample_name, sample_meta$sample_name)]]
    read_labels[, `:=`(pair_id = pair$pair_id, CRE_pair = pair$CRE_pair)]
    fwrite(read_labels, file.path(table_dir_noxci,
      paste0(pair$pair_id, "_read_labels_noXCI.tsv.gz")), sep = "\t")
    contributions <- read_labels[, .(n_shared = .N, co_access = sum(acc1 & acc2),
      CRE1_access = sum(acc1 & !acc2), CRE2_access = sum(!acc1 & acc2),
      co_closed = sum(!acc1 & !acc2)), by = .(pair_id, sample_name, donor)]
    fwrite(contributions, file.path(table_dir_noxci,
      paste0(pair$pair_id, "_sample_counts_noXCI.tsv")), sep = "\t")

    pair_data_noxci[[pair$pair_id]] <- list(pair = pair, region = region,
      cre1 = cre1, cre2 = cre2, res = res, labels = labels, counts = counts)
  }
}
```

```{r noxci-fiber-panels}
fiber_plots_noxci <- list()
fig_heights_noxci <- c()
for (id in names(pair_data_noxci)) {
  entry <- pair_data_noxci[[id]]
  pair <- entry$pair
  region <- entry$region
  counts <- entry$counts

  # window-spanning shared fibers, co-accessible first, capped at max_drawn
  spanning <- entry$res$spans[start <= region$start & end >= region$end, key]
  drawn_labels <- copy(entry$labels)[shared == TRUE & key %in% spanning]
  setorder(drawn_labels, config)
  n_spanning <- nrow(drawn_labels)
  if (n_spanning > max_drawn) drawn_labels <- drawn_labels[seq_len(max_drawn)]

  display_res <- load_ft_tracks(copy(entry$res), keys = drawn_labels$key,
    ft_root = paths$ft_root, tabix_bin = paths$tabix_bin,
    nuc_source = "ft", tf_source = "recalled_tf", tf_root = paths$tf_root)
  for (track in c("spans", "blocks", "elements", "m6a", "nuc", "size_fps")) {
    if (!is.null(display_res[[track]]) && nrow(display_res[[track]]))
      display_res[[track]][, sample_name := "pooled"]
  }
  display_res$samples <- "pooled"
  drawn_labels[, sample_name := "pooled"]

  cres_here <- cre_universe[chrom == region$chrom & end > region$start & start < region$end]
  region_res <- coaccess_region_result(display_res, entry$cre1, entry$cre2,
    drawn_labels, cres = cres_here)
  # co-accessible fibers on top, in both rasters
  rid_levels <- rev(levels(region_res$rids_df$RID))
  for (tb in c("reads", "rids_df", "fire", "nucs", "fps", "fps_infire")) {
    if (!is.null(region_res[[tb]]) && nrow(region_res[[tb]]))
      region_res[[tb]][["RID"]] <- factor(as.character(region_res[[tb]][["RID"]]),
                                          levels = rid_levels)
  }
  pk <- as.data.frame(cres_here)
  cls <- factor(pk$CRE_label, levels = c(intersect(CCRE_CLASSES, pk$CRE_label),
    setdiff(unique(pk$CRE_label), CCRE_CLASSES)))
  pk <- pk[order(cls, pk$start), , drop = FALSE]
  peaks_df <- data.frame(chr = pk$chrom, start = pk$start, end = pk$end,
    group = as.character(pk$CRE_label))

  subtitle <- sprintf("%s:%d-%d | %s", region$chrom, region$start, region$end,
    if (pair$chrom == "chrX") sprintf("chrX: %d male samples", length(male_samples_noxci))
    else sprintf("all %d samples", length(samples)))
  subtitle <- paste0(subtitle, "\n", sprintf(paste0(
    "%d fibers fully cover both cCREs: both %d | CRE1 only %d | CRE2 only %d | neither %d",
    " | Fisher OR (table + 1) = %.2f, p = %.2g"), counts$n_shared,
    counts$both, counts$cre1_only, counts$cre2_only, counts$neither,
    counts$fisher_or, counts$fisher_p))

  raster_height <- max(2, 0.025 * nrow(drawn_labels) + 0.3)
  heights <- c(pileup = 1.5, peaks = 0.3 + 0.3 * length(unique(peaks_df$group)),
    reads = raster_height, fire_fiberHMM = raster_height)
  read_theme <- list(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
  fiber_plots_noxci[[id]] <- plot_region_panels(region_res,
    plot_name = paste(id, pair$gene_names, pair$CRE_pair_labels,
      sprintf("%d of %d window-spanning fibers drawn, co-accessible first",
              nrow(drawn_labels), n_spanning), sep = " | "),
    subtitle = subtitle, peaks_df = peaks_df, highlight = region_res$highlight,
    linewidth = 1.1, expand = TRUE, heights = heights,
    profile_options = list(colour_by = "group", colors = cluster_palette("pooled"),
      y_col = "frac", linewidth = 0.4, facet_scales = "fixed",
      facet_space = "fixed", require_data = TRUE),
    read_options = list(tile_width = 8, tile_height = 0.85,
      backbone_col = BACKBONE_COL, arrows = FALSE,
      base_colors = c(A = M6A_COL), require_data = TRUE),
    peaks_options = list(variant = "intervals"),
    footprint_options = list(draw_order = c("linker", "nucleosome", "FIRE element",
      rev(region_res$size_levels)), backbone = FALSE, always = TRUE,
      legend_title = NULL, legend_drop = FALSE, legend_linewidth = 3),
    theme_options = list(base = "bw", base_size = 11,
      pileup = list(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)),
      reads = read_theme, fire_fiberHMM = read_theme),
    y_labels = c(pileup = "m6A fraction", reads = "m6A",
      fire_fiberHMM = "ft nucleosomes + FIRE + FiberHMM TF"),
    panel_names = c(peaks = "cres", pileup = "m6a_prop", reads = "m6a", fire_fiberHMM = "reads"))
  fig_heights_noxci[id] <- 6 + 0.05 * nrow(drawn_labels)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir_noxci, paste0(id, "_reads_noXCI.pdf")),
    fiber_plots_noxci[[id]]$combined, width = 12, height = fig_heights_noxci[[id]],
    limitsize = FALSE)
}
```

### top 5 co-accessible pairs ranked by # of co-accessible fibers

same filters as the top 10 without female chrx: fdr < 0.05, OR > 1, observed co-accessibility > expected

highest # of co-accessible fibers -> smallest FDR -> largest OR -> highest # of spanning molecules -> pair ID alphabetical order

```{r top-five-by-coaccess}
top5_noxci <- copy(eligible_noxci)
setorderv(top5_noxci, c("co_access_noXCI", "fdr_noXCI", "OR_noXCI", "n_shared_reads_noXCI", "CRE_pair"),
          c(-1L, 1L, -1L, -1L, 1L))
top5_noxci <- head(top5_noxci, 5L)
top5_noxci[, `:=`(
  region_start = pmax(0L, pmin(cre1_start, cre2_start) - as.integer(params$locus_flank_bp)),
  region_end = pmax(cre1_end, cre2_end) + as.integer(params$locus_flank_bp))]
top5_noxci[, pair_id := sprintf("noXCI_coaccess_top%d_%s_%d_%d", seq_len(.N), chrom,
                                region_start, region_end)]
fwrite(top5_noxci, file.path(table_dir_noxci, "LCL_top5_coaccess_pairs_noXCI.tsv"), sep = "\t")

head(top5_noxci[, .(pair_id, gene_names, CRE_pair, n_shared_reads_noXCI, co_access_noXCI,
  expected_co_access_noXCI, observed_expected_ratio_noXCI, OR_noXCI, fdr_noXCI)])
```

```{r top-five-fiber-panels}
fiber_plots_top5 <- list()
fig_heights_top5 <- c()
if (isTRUE(params$make_plots) && nrow(top5_noxci)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(top5_noxci))) {
    pair <- top5_noxci[i]
    id <- pair$pair_id
    pair_samples <- if (pair$chrom == "chrX") male_samples_noxci else samples
    region <- list(chrom = pair$chrom, start = pair$region_start, end = pair$region_end)
    cre1 <- list(start = pair$cre1_start, end = pair$cre1_end)
    cre2 <- list(start = pair$cre2_start, end = pair$cre2_end)
    res <- load_region(region, pair_samples, paths$root, paths$fire_root,
      fire_ver = paths$fire_ver, tabix_bin = paths$tabix_bin,
      span_source = "aligned_blocks")
    labels <- label_reads(res, cre1, cre2, fire_overlap_fraction = fire_overlap_fraction)
    counts <- coaccess_2x2(labels)

    # window-spanning shared fibers, co-accessible first, capped at max_drawn
    spanning <- res$spans[start <= region$start & end >= region$end, key]
    drawn_labels <- copy(labels)[shared == TRUE & key %in% spanning]
    setorder(drawn_labels, config)
    n_spanning <- nrow(drawn_labels)
    if (n_spanning > max_drawn) drawn_labels <- drawn_labels[seq_len(max_drawn)]

    display_res <- load_ft_tracks(copy(res), keys = drawn_labels$key,
      ft_root = paths$ft_root, tabix_bin = paths$tabix_bin,
      nuc_source = "ft", tf_source = "recalled_tf", tf_root = paths$tf_root)
    for (track in c("spans", "blocks", "elements", "m6a", "nuc", "size_fps")) {
      if (!is.null(display_res[[track]]) && nrow(display_res[[track]]))
        display_res[[track]][, sample_name := "pooled"]
    }
    display_res$samples <- "pooled"
    drawn_labels[, sample_name := "pooled"]

    cres_here <- cre_universe[chrom == region$chrom & end > region$start & start < region$end]
    region_res <- coaccess_region_result(display_res, cre1, cre2,
      drawn_labels, cres = cres_here)
    # co-accessible fibers on top, in both rasters
    rid_levels <- rev(levels(region_res$rids_df$RID))
    for (tb in c("reads", "rids_df", "fire", "nucs", "fps", "fps_infire")) {
      if (!is.null(region_res[[tb]]) && nrow(region_res[[tb]]))
        region_res[[tb]][["RID"]] <- factor(as.character(region_res[[tb]][["RID"]]),
                                            levels = rid_levels)
    }
    pk <- as.data.frame(cres_here)
    cls <- factor(pk$CRE_label, levels = c(intersect(CCRE_CLASSES, pk$CRE_label),
      setdiff(unique(pk$CRE_label), CCRE_CLASSES)))
    pk <- pk[order(cls, pk$start), , drop = FALSE]
    peaks_df <- data.frame(chr = pk$chrom, start = pk$start, end = pk$end,
      group = as.character(pk$CRE_label))

    subtitle <- sprintf("%s:%d-%d | %s", region$chrom, region$start, region$end,
      if (pair$chrom == "chrX") sprintf("chrX: %d male samples", length(male_samples_noxci))
      else sprintf("all %d samples", length(samples)))
    subtitle <- paste0(subtitle, "\n", sprintf(paste0(
      "%d fibers fully cover both cCREs: both %d | CRE1 only %d | CRE2 only %d | neither %d",
      " | Fisher OR (table + 1) = %.2f, p = %.2g"), counts$n_shared,
      counts$both, counts$cre1_only, counts$cre2_only, counts$neither,
      counts$fisher_or, counts$fisher_p))

    raster_height <- max(2, 0.025 * nrow(drawn_labels) + 0.3)
    heights <- c(pileup = 1.5, peaks = 0.3 + 0.3 * length(unique(peaks_df$group)),
      reads = raster_height, fire_fiberHMM = raster_height)
    read_theme <- list(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
    fiber_plots_top5[[id]] <- plot_region_panels(region_res,
      plot_name = paste(id, pair$gene_names, pair$CRE_pair_labels,
        sprintf("%d of %d window-spanning fibers drawn, co-accessible first",
                nrow(drawn_labels), n_spanning), sep = " | "),
      subtitle = subtitle, peaks_df = peaks_df, highlight = region_res$highlight,
      linewidth = 1.1, expand = TRUE, heights = heights,
      profile_options = list(colour_by = "group", colors = cluster_palette("pooled"),
        y_col = "frac", linewidth = 0.4, facet_scales = "fixed",
        facet_space = "fixed", require_data = TRUE),
      read_options = list(tile_width = 8, tile_height = 0.85,
        backbone_col = BACKBONE_COL, arrows = FALSE,
        base_colors = c(A = M6A_COL), require_data = TRUE),
      peaks_options = list(variant = "intervals"),
      footprint_options = list(draw_order = c("linker", "nucleosome", "FIRE element",
        rev(region_res$size_levels)), backbone = FALSE, always = TRUE,
        legend_title = NULL, legend_drop = FALSE, legend_linewidth = 3),
      theme_options = list(base = "bw", base_size = 11,
        pileup = list(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)),
        reads = read_theme, fire_fiberHMM = read_theme),
      y_labels = c(pileup = "m6A fraction", reads = "m6A",
        fire_fiberHMM = "ft nucleosomes + FIRE + FiberHMM TF"),
      panel_names = c(peaks = "cres", pileup = "m6a_prop", reads = "m6a", fire_fiberHMM = "reads"))
    fig_heights_top5[id] <- 6 + 0.05 * nrow(drawn_labels)
    ggsave(file.path(plot_dir_noxci, paste0(id, "_reads_noXCI.pdf")),
      fiber_plots_top5[[id]]$combined, width = 12, height = fig_heights_top5[[id]],
      limitsize = FALSE)
  }
}
